design_description: CDRH3 SLGSADYAFD (6 subs from trastuzumab). RFD4-Proteina generative. 6 subs. Epitope recall 4/4. Best interface H-bond of all candidates: residue-103 backbone O to HER2 Lys593 NZ at 2.51 A, tighter than the wild-type control fold (2.63 A). StaB-ddG 0.42 kcal/mol (2.0x WT). Cleanest developability scored: 5 liabilities vs wild-type 8. Carries neither F104P nor A106W, so it fails independently of the enumerated designs.

CDRH3 WGGRGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Epitope recall 4/4. Strongest all-round of the enumerated set: StaB-ddG 0.20+-0.16 kcal/mol (1.4x WT, statistically indistinguishable from wild-type) and interface H-bond retained at 3.48 A.

CDRH3 WGGMGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Epitope recall 4/4. Best StaB-ddG of all 18 candidates, 0.17+-0.17 kcal/mol (1.3x WT). Contacts Lys593 at 3.52 A but not via the residue-103 carbonyl, so the specific crystal H-bond is not reproduced.

CDRH3 WGHDGPYWMD (3 subs from trastuzumab). coworker, enumerated. 3 subs; keeps W99/G103/Y105. Epitope recall 4/4. Highest coworker-model P(beat trastuzumab), 0.244. Interface H-bond 4.07 A; StaB-ddG 0.50 kcal/mol (2.3x WT).
